notes.values: Effect values are in display units: unit "%" = percent (e.g. 8 means +8%), unit "flat" = plain number (e.g. element attack +50). A list of several values = by level (skill level is already split per entry; visage values are by visage level 1..max; buddy values are by Ascension phase 1..3).
notes.weapon_affinity: affinity_pct = raw game value / 100 (Pulsar Shotel II: 440 -> 4.4%, checked in game).
notes.always_on: always_on = true when the data applies the stat permanently while equipped. text_has_condition = true when the in-game text still mentions a condition - check those by hand.
notes.targets: target: self, squad (whole squad incl. you), main adventurer, monster (a debuff on the monster, e.g. its fire resistance -10% = your fire damage +10%).
notes.stats: AllElement* stats apply to whatever element the weapon has. *DamageResultPercentage = final element damage %; *Damage (no suffix) = flat element attack; AttackPercentage = attack %; DamagePercentage = all damage %; AffinityDamage = physical crit damage; ElementCriticalDamage = elemental crit damage.
notes.set_bonuses: An armour set tier grants the listed skill at the listed level (e.g. "Stun Resistance +1" = Stun Resistance Lv1). Add it to the same skill from armour/decorations, capped at skill_max_levels.
notes.skill_keys: Identify a skill by skill_type_id, not by name: two different skills are both called "Critical Element". skill_max_levels is keyed by skill_type_id.
notes.skill_levels: Skill levels from armour, set bonuses, decorations and Apex awakenings add up to the skill max level; then use the effects of the skills entry with that level.
notes.visages: base_attribute_slots: each slot rolls ONE option (odds_pct); values are by visage level 1..max. random_effect_slots unlock at the listed level; their options and values are in visage_random_pools.
notes.suggested_formula: Phys = (weapon attack + flat attack) x (1 + Attack%) x (1 + Physical damage%); Elem = (weapon element + flat element attack) x (1 + element attack%) x (1 + element damage%); crit = min(weapon affinity% + Affinity%, 100); Effective = [Phys x (1 + crit x (base crit + crit damage%)) + Elem x (1 + crit x (base elem crit + elemental crit damage%))] x (1 + Damage%) x (1 + Move damage%). Use only always_on effects for the steady score; add conditional ones for a best case.
notes.crit_base: Base crit multipliers are not in the client data. The in-game stat screen shows only bonus crit damage (Midori 0%/0%, Pyro 2% elemental crit damage), so the base is a hidden constant - keep it a setting.
